name: NexLoad
summary: A focused Windows workspace for downloading and managing supported online media.
headline: Download media. Stay in control.
description: Analyze links, select formats and quality, manage your download queue, and keep your media workflow in one organized desktop application.
note: Extract the ZIP completely before running NexLoad.exe. Keep the bundled folders together. Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime is required.
features: Link analysis
Inspect supported video and collection URLs before starting downloads.
Format control
Select available video and audio formats, quality options, and containers.
Queue management
Track jobs, cancellations, retries, and finished downloads.
Subtitle options
Choose supported subtitle languages and output options.
Audio extraction
Create supported audio-only downloads with media tooling.
Local library
Find previous downloads and organize output files.

name: ReelShift
summary: Preview, rename, and organize movies, TV episodes, and subtitles with confidence.
headline: Make your media library make sense.
description: Turn inconsistent filenames into a cleaner, more predictable media library. Review proposed changes before applying them, with control over naming and file organization.
note: Extract the complete portable ZIP to a writable folder and launch ReelShift.exe. Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime is required.
features: Smart file parsing
Identify supported movie, television episode, and subtitle filenames.
Review before rename
Inspect proposed names and destinations before making changes.
Rename-only mode
Keep files in place when you only want to tidy names.
Naming presets
Apply consistent naming and destination preferences.
Conflict checks
Surface naming collisions and files that need review.
History and undo
Review past operations and undo eligible changes.
